verdict.rationale: A state workforce and tax agency with online filing services could plausibly offer API credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no scoped or least-privilege credential mechanism. Access to UTR and UTS uses one shared user ID and password, QuickFile is a desktop file upload rather than an API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. The probe of the application host also observed it dropping a keyless agent's connection at robots.txt, so nothing there could be checked.
